When volatility falls first and credit stays wide, the relief is often early and fragile. The credit data is two days old, so it may already be stale.
- **VXN has not followed VIX.** VXN is 30.53 while VIX is 18.21 (one is a live quote, the other a close). Nasdaq volatility stays high even as S&P volatility falls. For TQQQ this matters more than VIX.
- **Gold is rising with a falling VIX.** Gold is up 2.82% while VIX dropped 12.58%. Normally a calm tape pulls gold down. A bid for both safety and risk suggests the relief is not trusted.
- **Yields are rising into the relief.** The 10Y is 4.952%, only 0.048 points under the 5.00% bullish-leg line.

- Put-selling context: HOSTILE, with early easing. Structure is DOWNTURN, spot is below both moving averages, and credit lines are still crossed. VIX has dropped under 20 on a live quote, news has cooled from SHOCK to CAUTION, and spot has moved 2.2% off the 4-week low. Against that, Iran strikes are active, NFP on Nov 6 falls inside the next five sessions, and CPI on Nov 10 is just outside it. IV/HV fell to 1.11, so premium is less rich than last read.
